\edef\missing{\filesize{nosuchfile.tex}}
\edef\present{\filesize{pgfplots.sty}}
\ifx\missing\empty\else\errmessage{\string\filesize\space of a file that does not exist gave "\missing"}\fi
\ifnum0\present>0 \else\errmessage{\string\filesize\space of pgfplots.sty gave "\present"}\fi
\IfFileExists{nosuchfile.sty}{\errmessage{\string\IfFileExists\space found nosuchfile.sty}}{}
\IfFileExists{pgfplots.sty}{}{\errmessage{\string\IfFileExists\space did not find pgfplots.sty}}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\node {pgfplots.sty is \present\ bytes};
\end{tikzpicture}
